items.title: The actual normalized Gibbs augmentation law

source.anchor: Section 2.2 equations (2.6)-(2.7); positive Hessian setting in introduction (1.1)
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS mathematical restatement with explicit normalization details, not copied prose or author endorsement.

items.statement: In the paper's Euclidean C² setting αI≤D²V≤βI with 0<α≤β and 0<η≤1/β, the target μ has normalized density Z_V^{-1}exp(-V). The joint density proportional to exp(-V(x)-||x-y||²/(2η)) is the law of X~μ and Y=X+sqrt(η)N for independent standard Gaussian N. Its exact normalizing factor is (2πη)^(-d/2)/Z_V. ASTIS makes finite positive Gibbs mass and probability of this law explicit.
assumptions: The primary source assumes V∈C²(R^d), 0<α≤β and αI≤D²V(x)≤βI globally, in (1.1).
Section 2.2 fixes 0<η≤1/β. The noise N has covariance I and is independent of X.

The normalization convention uses Euclidean Lebesgue volume and Z_V=∫exp(-V(x))dx. The source writes the joint density up to proportionality; this packet supplies its exact factor and positive finite mass.

obligations.label: Derive strictly positive finite Gibbs mass from genuine source curvature, without an assumed minimizer
Certify that the independent Gaussian augmentation is a probability measure
Identify that actual joint law with the exact source density relative to product volume

bindings.boundary: Exact normalized joint-law component (2.6)-(2.7), not conditional kernels, curvature conclusions, process invariance, mixing or query cost. Independent source-blind semantic audit is required for admission.

assumption_deltas.source: C² Euclidean V and lower matrix bound αI≤D²V, α>0
assumption_deltas.lean: ContDiff ℝ 2 V, hα:0<α, and ∀x v, α*||v||²≤(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v
assumption_deltas.reason: The quadratic-form version expresses the lower Hessian bound. C² guarantees genuine first and second derivatives; a zero totalized derivative without differentiability cannot replace this hypothesis.

assumption_deltas.lean: Any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E, including dimension zero, with canonical volume
assumption_deltas.reason: The shared analytic and Gaussian parents are coordinate-free and include zero dimension. The volume normalization is fixed by the inner product, not an arbitrary Haar measure.

Only lower curvature is used to normalize the Gibbs target. Gaussian augmentation and density multiplication hold at every positive scale. The omitted upper constraints are retained in separate sampler/curvature obligations.

assumption_deltas.source: Normalized Gibbs notation and joint-density proportionality
assumption_deltas.lean: Explicit 0<Z_V and IsProbabilityMeasure joint as well as the exact density equality
assumption_deltas.reason: Existing parent proofs establish exp(-V) integrability without a minimizer. Positive exponential mass excludes zero normalization; the explicit probability conclusion prevents the displayed equality from being satisfied only by a zero totalized tilted law.

assumption_deltas.lean: Product measure and proved measurable pushforward, with measurable product-density multiplication
assumption_deltas.reason: The Borel continuity witnesses and product measure contracts are supplied internally. No conditional representative, boundary integration or exchange of improper integrals is assumed.
Norm symmetry changes x-y to y-x without changing the value; the natural-power square-root expression is exactly the same Gaussian normalization.
